title: RFID Silicone Wristbands
description: Reusable RFID silicone wristbands for water parks, gyms, resorts and events, with waterproof construction and LF, HF, NFC or UHF chip options.
summary: Reusable RFID silicone wristbands with waterproof, comfortable construction for water parks, gyms, resorts and event access or payment programs.
A broad selection of molds: with over 50 finely crafted RFID silicone wristband models to choose from.
Enhanced tactile experience: ProudTek uses meticulous craftsmanship to create a skin-like surface for the RFID silicone wristbands.

faq.question: What are RFID Silicone Wristbands commonly used for?
faq.answer: Best for reusable wristband programs in water parks, gyms, resorts, clubs, and events where comfort, waterproofing, and frequent reuse matter.

faq.question: Which chip, protocol, or frequency options are available for RFID Silicone Wristbands?
faq.answer: Chip: EM4200, ATA5577, MIFARE Classic S50/S70, MIFARE DESFire, Ntag213, Ntag215, Ntag216 Protocol: ISO14443A, ISO15693 etc. Frequency: 125khz, 13.56mhz, 915mhz,

faq.question: What material or form-factor options are available for RFID Silicone Wristbands?
faq.answer: Material: Silicone Dimensions: 150mm,180mm,195mm,210mm, etc. Color: Black, blue, red, orange, yellow, green, purple, white, or customized.

faq.question: How can RFID Silicone Wristbands be customized?
faq.answer: Printing: silkscreen printing, laser engraving+pigment filling
